lut.note: pixel x = index of the colour in `index` (the 48 tile colours, then the 2 bot lilacs); pixels 50-255 are unused (transparent)

transform.formula: lum = .30R+.59G+.11B; c' = c*(1-desat) + lum*desat; out = c'*mul + add
transform.note: affine, so it can run as a shader / colour matrix on the whole frame and gives the same result as the LUT on blended pixels

order: 1. world (ground, shadows, props, buildings; NOT characters) recoloured by the LUT / transform, then layer=emissive sprites (lit_windows over each bay, lamp_head, wall_lamp_head, string_lights) unrecoloured

2. characters, never recoloured by the LUT: multiply tint `characters.shade` (mild night shade, faint blue), lerped to white (= original colours) by the light factor of the nearest light source; they stay in the same depth-sorted layer as the props
3. layer=light sprites with blend=add on top of everything (lamp glows, window lights, cone, siren, underglow, string_lights_glow)

characters.formula: light = max over sources of clamp((1 - dist/radius) / (1 - lit_inner), 0, 1); dist from the body centre (origin - 24 px) to the light centre; tint = shade + (1 - shade) * light (per channel, multiply)
characters.sources: lamp heads (radius of their lamp_glow), wall lamps (24), lit panes (half the pane diagonal + 16), fountain underglow (40)

lamp_glow_s.note: radius 24 px, warm (y0 rim, y2 core), Bayer-dithered edge; centre on the lamp head; alternate frames at random for flicker

lamp_glow_m.note: radius 40 px, warm (y0 rim, y2 core), Bayer-dithered edge; centre on the lamp head; alternate frames at random for flicker

lamp_glow_l.note: radius 56 px, warm (y0 rim, y2 core), Bayer-dithered edge; centre on the lamp head; alternate frames at random for flicker

window_light_s.note: pane 8x12 px + 6 px dithered halo; centre on the window glass

window_light_m.note: pane 14x22 px + 6 px dithered halo; centre on the window glass

window_light_l.note: pane 24x28 px + 6 px dithered halo; centre on the window glass

delegacia_cone.note: security (Delegacia) door lamp: top centre at the lamp, falls onto the sidewalk

siren_flash.note: frame 0 red, 1 blue; top-left = siren tile top-left + (-16, -16)

fountain_underglow.note: warm, dithered; same top-left as the fountain

string_lights.note: 64 px segment, wire ends at y=3 on both edges

lamp_head.note: lit pixels of `lamp_night`, same placement; draw after the LUT so the lamp stays bright

lit_windows.note: night versions of the 1x2 bay overlays, frame order = window_arched, window_square, window_shop, window_pair, door_glass, door_panel, door_arched
